items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio 3D Editor + Canvas
items.why: 此重大平台更新強化了 AI 綁骨後的場景創建、動畫控制及 MetaHuman 導出功能，提供更完整的 AI 驅動工作流程。
items.why_en: This major platform update enhances scene creation, animation control, and MetaHuman export capabilities after AI rigging, offering a more complete AI-driven workflow.

items.name: Armature
items.why: 一款新發佈的 AI 輔助獨立角色綁骨和蒙皮工具，支援多種 3D 格式並可導出 USD，對獨立藝術家免費。
items.why_en: A newly released AI-assisted standalone character rigging and skinning tool, supporting various 3D formats and USD export, free for indie artists.

items.name: Character Control Rig for Blender
items.why: Blender 附加元件的重要更新，新增動畫重定向引擎並支援 Auto-Rig Pro 框架，提升 MetaHuman 角色綁骨效率。
items.why_en: A significant update to a Blender add-on, adding a new animation retargeting engine and support for the Auto-Rig Pro framework, improving MetaHuman character rigging efficiency.

items.name: Meshy-6 Auto-Rig + Animate
items.why: 作為領先的 AI 3D 創作平台，Meshy 持續提供強大的自動綁骨和動畫功能，並有近期指南發佈，廣受業界關注。
items.why_en: As a leading AI 3D creation platform, Meshy continuously offers powerful auto-rigging and animation features, with recent guides published, garnering widespread industry attention.

items.name: V2Fun
items.why: 一個整合 AI 3D 模型生成、自動綁骨和動畫的平台，提供從概念到動畫資產的完整工作流程。
items.why_en: An integrated AI 3D model generator, auto-rigging, and animation platform, offering a complete workflow from concept to animated asset.

categories.name: 創建聲音特效
categories.subtitle: SFX / 語音 / 音樂 · 例如 ElevenLabs

overall.name: ElevenLabs SFX v2 + v3 voice
overall.why: 遊戲音訊最全:文字轉 SFX(30s、可無縫循環)+ 頂級語音
overall.why_en: Most complete game-audio stack: text-to-SFX (30s, seamless loops) + top-tier voice

overall.name: Suno v5
overall.why: 音樂盲測第一(ELO 1293);全曲+人聲質量標竿
overall.why_en: #1 in music blind tests (ELO 1293); full-song + vocal benchmark

overall.name: ElevenLabs Music v2
overall.why: 商用授權清晰,可在曲中嵌 SFX、中途換曲風
overall.why_en: Clear commercial licensing; embed SFX in tracks, mid-track genre switch

overall.name: Stable Audio 3
overall.why: 開源,音樂 + SFX/foley 統一,適合自架 pipeline
overall.why_en: Open-source; unified music + SFX/foley; great for self-hosted pipelines

overall.name: Lyria 3 Pro
overall.why: 最長 3 分鐘結構化曲目,SynthID 浮水印
overall.why_en: Up to 3-min structured tracks; SynthID watermark

monthly.note: 本月新發佈項目不足五個，已用近期發佈補足。
monthly.note_en: Fewer than five new releases this month; recent releases from the past 30-60 days have been included to complete the list.

items.name: Suno Studio
items.why: Suno 的瀏覽器版 DAW 大幅升級，新增 MIDI 編輯、音效插件、自動化等功能，顯著提升音樂創作控制力。
items.why_en: Suno's browser-based DAW received a significant upgrade, adding MIDI editing, audio effects plugins, automation, and more, greatly enhancing music creation control.

items.name: MiniMax Music
items.why: 新一代音樂生成模型，專注於理解創作者的表達意圖、維持長達五分鐘的歌曲連貫性，並提供更清晰自然的樂器與人聲。
items.why_en: Next-generation music generation model focusing on understanding expressive intent, sustaining coherence for up to five-minute songs, and rendering clearer, more natural instruments and vocals.

items.name: ElevenLabs Dubbing API
items.why: 正式發佈 Dubbing v2 API，支援 90 多種語言的音訊和視訊翻譯，同時保留原始語音的音調和語速，提升在地化內容品質。
items.why_en: Officially released the Dubbing v2 API, supporting audio and video translation in over 90 languages while preserving original voice, tone, and pacing, enhancing localization quality.

items.name: Speechify Simba
items.why: 在 Artificial Analysis TTS 排行榜中名列前茅，提供從約 10 秒音訊進行零樣本語音複製的能力，語音生成表現優異。
items.why_en: Ranked highly on the Artificial Analysis TTS leaderboard, offering zero-shot voice cloning from approximately 10 seconds of audio with excellent voice generation performance.

items.name: Stable Audio
items.why: 發佈了包含四個模型的音訊生成系列，支援長達六分鐘的音樂和音效生成，部分模型提供開源權重，並專為商業用途設計。
items.why_en: Released a family of four audio generation models, supporting music and sound effect generation up to six minutes long, with open weights for some models and designed for commercial use.
